implemented_routines.name: annunciator_row
implemented_routines.scope: Clear the complete twelve-byte87D0 row, set modifier/scalar/mode/angle/format/math/result/history indicators in native bus-write order, and copy all twelve bytes toF800. Classify immutable8226 and modeC4-only8408 through the shared native scalar value predicate, preserving compact-surd zero/sign behavior.

api.draw: fx_annunciator_draw(fx_platform *) returns0 success, -1 for an invalid platform, or the negative scalar-classifier status; a classifier failure retains preceding row writes and does not update the LCD.

gaps: Native scalar-classifier numeric scratch8000..805F and8640..867B is absent from the host value API, and original CPU call-stack writes are not reproduced.
Malformed compact-surds outside the shared classifier value domain are explicitly unsupported through its negative status.
Physical LCD timing, interrupts, outer key/action controllers and full firmware lifecycle remain outside this routine API.

verification.comparison: Complete persistent RAM/LCD/MMIO, every persistent per-address bus-write count, selected ordered bus-write traces, immutable scalar sources, surrounding-buffer preservation and callback events. Numeric scratch8000..805F/8640..867B and CPU call stack8D00..8DED are excluded explicitly.
verification.limitation: Routine-level passive peripheral oracle; no firmware-completion claim.
